verses.1: And the words of Jehovah were spoken by His angels.
verses.2: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “I long for Zion with great longing and intense desire. I long for her!”
verses.3: Thus said Yahweh: “I will return to Zion, and I will dwell within Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the true city, and the Temple of Yahweh will be called the Holy Mountain.”
verses.4: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “Old men and old women shall be seated in the streets of Jerusalem. No one will have anything to eat from his own fields for many days.”
verses.5: And the streets of the city were filled with children and girls, who played in the streets.
verses.6: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “In those days, this people will be destroyed in the eyes of others. But in my eyes, they will be destroyed as well.” Amen, Jehovah, the God of hosts.
verses.7: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “I will save my people from the land of the east and from the land where the sun rises.”
verses.8: And I brought them here, and they settled within the walls of Jerusalem. They became my people. And I will truly be their God, in truth and righteousness.
verses.9: As Jehovah the Lord says: May your hands be strengthened, so that you may hear these words from the prophets. These words were given to them on the day when the house of Jehovah, the heavenly kingdom, was established for its construction.
verses.10: For in those days, man’s wages will not exist. The wages of animals also won’t be given. There will be no peace for those who come and go. I will send every person to their own place.
verses.11: And now, as in those early days, I will no longer be the ruler of this people forever. May the Lord, the Almighty, have mercy on them.
verses.12: For the seed of peace, the apple tree will bear fruit. The earth will give forth its harvests. The heavens will send down rain. And I will give to this remaining people all of these things.
verses.13: And just as you were a curse among the nations of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, so too will I save you. Then you will be blessed, and your hands will be strengthened.
verses.14: For as Jehovah said, “I will do you harm at the time of your ancestors’ destruction.” But Jehovah did not relent.
verses.15: So, in these days, I have spent time trying to restore Jerusalem and the House of Judah. Do not be afraid.
verses.16: These are the things that will be done. People will speak truth to one another, and they will judge fairly in their own homes.
verses.17: And do not think evil of your enemies. Do not love falsehoods, for all those whom I have loved, say the Lord.
verses.18: And the words of Jehovah were spoken to me.
verses.19: As Jehovah said, “The fourth angel, the fifth angel, the seventh angel, and the eighth angel will come. They will bring joy, happiness, and good things to the house of Judah.”
verses.20: Thus said Jehovah, the Lord of hosts: “When nations and people from many cities come.”
verses.21: And the people from one place went to another, saying, “Let us go to worship God’s face. Let us seek God, our Creator.” I too will go with them.
verses.22: And many nations and great peoples came to ask for the help of Jehovah, the Almighty, in Jerusalem. They also wept before the face of Jehovah.
verses.23: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts, in those days when ten men shall be chosen from all nations to be leaders among them. Each of these leaders will hold the shield of a Jewish man, and they will say, “Let us go with you, for we have heard God speak through you.”
